source_snapshot.test_name_items: All SAS/SATA NVMe LED Check - Locate
source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check if NVMe RAID locate LED function works normally

1. Insert NVMe SSD into BP slot
2. Select NVMe adapter and locate NVMe SSD
3. Check locate LED

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: 1. Check system spec define LED function

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: Undocumented raw IPMI bytes plus `lsblk` inventory.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: Management result, device list and Locate observation.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; preserves operator observation but leaves transport unresolved and provides no validated target or stop operation.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; adds transport decision, stable identity, paired Locate start/stop and safe insertion.

original_test_intent: Verify the physical Locate/UID indicator across all approved drive bays, but the source conflicts between SAS/SATA scope and an explicitly NVMe adapter/SSD procedure.
original_method: After the owner selects the transport, map each drive serial to its transport-specific controller/enclosure/bay, have an operator insert it, run the documented paired Locate start/status/stop operation, and visually confirm the correct bay.
manual_activity: Physical insertion and visible bay confirmation are manual core acceptance, but the incompatible source labels prevent selecting the drive, bay and Locate interface safely.
required_inputs: Locate color/pattern and expected on/off behavior
Documented start/status/stop method for selected controller
Insertion power state, operator evidence and wrong/stuck LED recovery
safety_requirements: Do not insert hardware or send Locate while transport is unresolved.
Exclude boot, data-bearing, protected and unknown drives.
Do not infer bay from OS device order or use undocumented IPMI raw bytes.
Operate one stable target at a time and include the matching stop.
No automatic adjacent-bay or alternate-transport retry.
agent_execution_scope: Record the conflict and prepare distinct SAS/SATA and NVMe target maps.
After resolution, validate stable identity and run approved paired Locate operations.
Correlate command and system events with operator media and verify cleanup.
Do not claim physical observation or verdict.
engineer_actions: Resolve transport and approve population/Locate method.
Perform insertion and visually record correct-bay on/off behavior.
Resolve wrong/stuck state and issue PASS/FAIL.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Not usable: the raw command lacks OEM transport/bay mapping and stop semantics; `lsblk` cannot prove a physical Locate result.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Do not issue management writes before scope resolution; then use documented transport-native paired Locate operations.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: SAS/SATA naming, NVMe adapter/SSD procedure, Locate criterion and 15/8-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: After resolution, run a one-at-a-time all-bay matrix with stable identities, paired start/stop and synchronized before/on/off media.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Selected SAS/SATA or NVMe path only.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record controller/adapter/backplane/BMC firmware and utility versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Selected transport's Locate/UID and slot specifications.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds target proof/cleanup and separates incompatible hardware.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: CLI acceptance cannot prove the physical bay illuminated.

project_override_considerations: A project override may select one transport and declared population, but cannot claim the other transport or untested bays.
expected_evidence: Owner transport decision, population and LED specification
Exact Locate start/status/stop transcript and target identity
Per-bay on/off media, final health, Tool Result and verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Test Set/item specify SAS/SATA while procedure explicitly selects an NVMe adapter and SSD. Locate addressing and physical bay mapping differ by transport.

blocked_analysis.analysis: No unique safe target or command can be chosen until transport is resolved; this is a core operation ambiguity.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Rejects unvalidated raw control and missing stop/transport semantics.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Adopts its safeguards but changes conditional partial to BLOCKED until owner resolution.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates manual physical acceptance from the prior review's ambiguous management path.

review_improvement: Prevents Locate from being sent to the wrong controller family or physical bay.
independent_technical_reasoning: Locate is command-driven but the transport determines both address and physical mapping. Without that decision, even a human observation would not establish the intended source case.
no_automatic_retry: No physical or Locate operation is allowed before transport resolution.
